intro: Your living room finds its center in Raffin. The sleek curves, floating panel, and upholstered finish give you a modern table that doubles as a seat, making every gathering flexible and stylish.

features.title: Floating panel for flexible use
features.text: Slide the circular panel where you need it, whether to set your laptop, serve coffee, or display a favorite décor piece, keeping every moment practical and personal.

features.title: Doubles as extra seating
features.text: When guests arrive, the coffee table converts to a sturdy bench, giving you a quick, stylish solution for seating without cluttering your space.

features.title: Fully upholstered body for luxury
features.text: Soft leatherette upholstery wraps the table, adding comfort if used as a bench and lending a plush, premium feel when used as a centerpiece.

features.title: Brown that softens your space
features.text: The soft brown leatherette finish adds warmth and elegance, making the table feel inviting while blending with lighter woods and neutral tones.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
name: Raffin Multi Purpose Coffee Table With Sitting Desk Function Soft Brown
